plain_text:
There are two CVB label mounting sheet templates - one in Word format and one in PDF format. Each
mounting sheet provides standard headers and footers for label submissions, which will appear on every
page of the submission. The footer also contains an area for an electronic signature by CVB and the text
seen on the processing stamps as on paper submissions. Only one of the templates needs to be used for the
label.

plain_text:
It is permissible to increase the page size to accommodate oversized labels. It is not necessary to specify a paper
size for which you have the paper/printer available to print hard copies as the label submission is an entirely
electronic process.

plain_text:
1. Replaces Label or Sketch: List all labels or Sketches that are being replaced.

2. Master Label: Submit smallest size final container, enter all dose sizes.

3. Translation: Choose “Co-submitted” if translation was submitted with label, choose “On
Label” if translation is on the label or “No” if there is no translation.

4. Export Only: Choose Yes or No.

5. Comments: If you have any additional comments they can be placed here.
